name: bme280
title: BME280 environment sensor
description: Rack temperature, humidity and pressure from a BME280 on I2C. The dashboard works normally without it.
notes: Enable I2C (sudo raspi-config nonint do_i2c 0), wire the sensor to the I2C pins and check it with: i2cdetect -y 1. Address and bus: HOMEISLAND_BME280_ADDRESS / HOMEISLAND_BME280_BUS.
